info.name: Dabbler API — deterministic smoke
info.description: Repository-owned API regression against the Supabase REST/Auth surface. Read-only requests, anon key only. Variables SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY come from the environment at run time (tests/api/run.sh); nothing secret is stored in this file. Cases: success, authentication enforced, service health. Extend per work item with the smallest request that would catch the same defect next time — never a speculative suite.
